author: HopeTech
name: HopeTech.Common API host
description: The composition root for an API on HopeTech.Common: Program.cs, the product DbContext, validated settings, launch profiles, and a health endpoint. Run it once, inside a restored Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web project, with --force so it may replace the files `dotnet new web` left behind.

rootNamespace.description: Read from the host project's RootNamespace. Resolves only in a project that has been restored - in an unrestored one the namespaces come out as the default and have to be fixed by hand.

dbContext.description: The name of the product's EF Core context. Deliberately not taken from -n: an item template's -n defaults to the output directory name, which is never what a context should be called.

audience.description: The JWT audience this API accepts, written into appsettings.Development.json.

database.description: The LocalDB database name for development.

webOrigin.description: The browser origin allowed through CORS in development.

skipLaunchSettings.description: Omit Properties/launchSettings.json, for a project whose launch profiles are already right.

skipHealthEndpoint.description: Omit the health controller and its response contract.

skipAuthEndpoints.description: Omit the register and sign-in controller. The library supplies IAuthService and the contracts either way; without this controller nothing exposes them over HTTP.
